name: tenants
description: Business identity and lifecycle; fixture names never define product logic.
fields: status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active','suspended','closed'))

name: principals
description: Application actor mapped to authentication identity.
privacy: Account PII; authenticated self and authorized administration

name: memberships
description: Business membership, independent of driver work relationship.
fields: status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('invited','active','suspended','revoked'))

name: cities
description: Configured service area; city label is not security authority.
fields: enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true

name: city_grants
description: Explicit membership access to a city.

name: brands
description: Tenant-owned brand and customer tracking identity.

name: sites
description: Pickup/hub/base/site identity; geographic source and verification are explicit.

name: feature_entitlements
description: Capability eligibility distinct from operator feature preferences.

name: policy_versions
description: Immutable typed setting payloads; schema_version identifies validated JSON schema.

name: policy_bindings
description: Current effective pointer; overrides resolve by domain-specific precedence.

name: tenant_subscriptions
description: Commercial entitlement record; no invented prices.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('trial','active','past_due','cancelled'))

name: usage_ledger
description: Metered usage deduplicated by original business event.

name: drivers
description: One driver identity across employers and Network.
privacy: Global identity; server projections, never public driver table

name: driver_relationships
description: Team or known freelancer relationship, not a permanent global category.
fields: relationship_kind text NOT NULL CHECK (relationship_kind IN ('team','known_freelancer'))
status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('invited','active','suspended','ended'))
outside_work_allowed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false

name: invitations
description: Hashed invitation token, actor, expiry and one-time consumption.

name: driver_contact_permissions
description: Driver-controlled permission per known merchant relationship.
fields: messages_allowed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
availability_requests_allowed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false

name: driver_devices
description: Revocable device registration, push token reference and session epoch.

name: onboarding_drafts
description: Persisted typed onboarding draft and branch with real evidence references.
privacy: Encrypted restricted identity draft; no raw documents in JSON

name: verification_applications
description: Application receipt and review state independent of availability.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('draft','submitted','pending','approved','rejected','correction_required'))

name: verification_evidence
description: Document/face evidence references and correction lineage.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('reserved','uploaded','verified','rejected','superseded'))
privacy: Private object references, no browser-readable public documents

name: payout_methods
description: Tokenized/encrypted bank or PromptPay reference with masked display.
fields: verification_state text NOT NULL CHECK (verification_state IN ('pending','verified','rejected'))
privacy: Financial restricted data; never plaintext bank/ID in events

name: availability_declarations
description: Driver intent; freshness and accepted obligations evaluated separately.
fields: intent text NOT NULL CHECK (intent IN ('paused','open','open_later'))

name: availability_requests
description: Opted-in relationship question, never an offer/booking.
rules: CHECK (response IS NULL OR response IN ('available','unavailable','later'))
CHECK ((response='later' AND available_after IS NOT NULL) OR (response IS DISTINCT FROM 'later' AND available_after IS NULL))

name: vehicle_types
description: Display catalogue: motorbike_box, tuk_tuk, car, pickup, van; extensible mapping.
fields: enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true

name: cargo_classes
description: Named physical capacity dimension with explicit unit.
fields: discrete boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true

name: vehicle_profiles
description: Versioned defaults for departure capacity and timing; snapshot on commitments.

name: profile_cargo_limits
description: Class quantity limit; zero prohibits class.

name: handling_rules
description: Allowed/preferred/required capability rule using a typed selector.
fields: effect text NOT NULL CHECK (effect IN ('allowed','preferred','required','prohibited'))

name: vehicles
description: Tenant vehicle instance, reusable type/profile and service status.
fields: status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('available','unavailable','maintenance','archived'))

name: freelance_vehicles
description: Driver-owned vehicle; merchant sees authorized capability projection.
fields: status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending','verified','unavailable','archived'))

name: shift_templates
description: Recurring schedule, effective dates and explicit overnight local minutes.
fields: start_minute integer NOT NULL CHECK (start_minute>=0 AND start_minute<1440)

name: shift_occurrences
description: Resolved dated shift, including off-day/one-off override provenance.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('scheduled','started','on_break','ended','no_show','cancelled'))

name: attendance_events
description: Append-only start/end and correction requests/decisions, not payroll.

name: slot_templates
description: Named delivery-window identity; historical versions retained.
fields: enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true

name: slot_template_versions
description: Immutable recurring slot timing and allocation policy in local minutes from service-date midnight.

name: slot_overrides
description: One dated override per template; closure or complete resolved replacement values.

name: slot_occurrences
description: Resolved immutable promise basis plus independently versioned admission controls; issued promises stay on delivery snapshot.
fields: admission_state text NOT NULL CHECK (admission_state IN ('open','closed','overcommitted','superseded'))

name: slot_reservations
description: Atomic capacity reservation for a draft/source delivery; held expiry is server-owned.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('held','committed','released','expired'))
rules: CHECK (state<>'held' OR (draft_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND committed_at IS NULL))
CHECK (state<>'committed' OR (delivery_id IS NOT NULL AND committed_at IS NOT NULL))

name: source_connections
description: Commerce connection config, authorization and health independently recorded.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('active','paused','error','disconnected'))

name: source_events
description: Authenticated webhook/request inbox; safely retained minimized payload and processing result.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('received','normalized','review_required','applied','rejected','conflict'))

name: intake_batches
description: Manual/import/AI batch job and source evidence reference.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('draft','processing','review_ready','committing','completed','partial_failed','failed'))

name: intake_drafts
description: Editable normalized draft; original source retained; no assignment effect.
fields: review_state text NOT NULL CHECK (review_state IN ('draft','extracting','review_needed','ready','committed','discarded'))

name: address_suggestions
description: AI/geocoder candidate with before/after, allowed provenance, expiry and reviewed disposition.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('proposed','accepted','edited','rejected','superseded'))
rules: CHECK (confidence IS NULL OR confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1)

name: entrances
description: Building/site entrance identity; recipient unit data stored separately.

name: entrance_revisions
description: Immutable reviewed entrance/access knowledge with attribution and licensed-source metadata.

name: location_observations
description: Candidate measured observation; review does not change earlier delivery evidence.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('proposed','reviewed','accepted','rejected'))

name: deliveries
description: Stable doorstep obligation; readiness, outcome and evidence dimensions are distinct.
fields: readiness text NOT NULL CHECK (readiness IN ('draft','review_needed','ready','held'))
outcome text NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('open','delivered','partially_delivered','rescheduled','returned','cancelled','unresolved'))
evidence_state text NOT NULL CHECK (evidence_state IN ('none','local_only','pending','complete','disputed'))
preparation_state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK (preparation_state IN ('unknown','preparing','ready','blocked'))

name: delivery_contacts
description: Buyer, recipient, pickup and alternate are explicit roles; secret contact values encrypted.

name: manifests
description: Immutable physical-content revision; new version before pickup requires explicit revalidation.

name: manifest_lines
description: Identified line and expected amount; one quantity two line is not two anonymous taps.
fields: handling_keys text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT ARRAY[]::text[]

name: packages
description: Optional independently identified parcel, not inferred from product quantity.

name: package_contents
description: Identified package contents with line quantities; sums validated transactionally.

name: plans
description: City/date draft planning aggregate.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('draft','generating','review_ready','saved','released','superseded'))

name: plan_proposals
description: Immutable before/after proposal, inputs/policy hashes and allowed route artifact references.
fields: version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version=1)

name: plan_releases
description: Released snapshot; uncovered scope and approval recorded.

name: rounds
description: Local work commitment; pickup/date/city coherent.
fields: fulfillment_kind text NOT NULL CHECK (fulfillment_kind IN ('team','freelance'))
state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('draft','planned','staged','released','active','completed','cancelled'))
departure_gate text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'awaiting_preparation' CHECK (departure_gate IN ('awaiting_preparation','awaiting_receipt','discrepancy','ready','blocked'))
operational_hold boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false

name: stops
description: Pickup, dropoff, return, transfer; stable stop identity survives sequence edits.
fields: kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('pickup','dropoff','return','transfer'))
state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('planned','released','en_route','arrived','handed_over','completed','failed','cancelled'))
rules: UNIQUE (tenant_id, round_id, sequence) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

name: assignments
description: Team-issued work and response state with originating release/change.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('issued','received','acknowledged','cannot_comply','withdrawn','superseded','completed'))
origin text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'team' CHECK(origin IN ('team','freelance'))

name: driver_commitments
description: Global exclusion of overlapping committed work without cross-merchant data exposure.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending','committed','cancelled','completed'))
rules: CHECK (NOT lower_inf(busy_range) AND NOT upper_inf(busy_range) AND lower_inc(busy_range) AND NOT upper_inc(busy_range))
privacy: Server-only global conflict checks; external callers receive only conflict reason

name: active_delivery_claims
description: Single live assignment/search owner per delivery; settled history in events.

name: delivery_attempts
description: Explicit execution attempt, not rewritten by retry/reschedule.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending','en_route','arrived','handed_over','completed','failed','cancelled'))

name: custody_events
description: Append-only signed-actor physical collection/handoff/return/transfer record.

name: custody_event_lines
description: Per-event physical line quantity. Net holdings validated under locked manifest.

name: custody_balances
description: Transactional projection of known held quantities by custodian; rebuildable from events.

name: handoffs
description: Physical delivery handoff separate from durable proof completion.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('recorded','disputed','corrected'))

name: assets
description: Server-owned upload reservation and verified object metadata. No bytes inline.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('reserved','uploading','uploaded','scanning','verified','rejected','expired'))
privacy: Private object; purpose-bound signed upload/read and audit

name: proof_submissions
description: Two-phase evidence submission, policy snapshot and actor.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending','complete','disputed','retained_for_review','rejected'))

name: proof_items
description: Manifest confirmation/photo/signature/receiver evidence requirements and durable receipts.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending','verified','invalidated','rejected'))
rules: ADR-T06: immutable typed proof content, exact note and actual same-tenant arrival observation; migration0005 upgrades without backfilling evidence.

name: issues
description: Typed incident: recipient/address/package/wait/cannot-complete/emergency.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('open','investigating','decided','resolved'))

name: issue_decisions
description: Attributed instructions/approval and customer/freelancer consent references.

name: return_tasks
description: Explicit return obligation and receiving site; related line quantities retained.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('planned','in_transit','arrived','receiving','received','disputed','cancelled'))

name: change_proposals
description: Immutable proposed material diff plus consent/ack lifecycle.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending','applied','acknowledged','accepted','declined','withdrawn','expired','superseded'))
mode text NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('instruct','propose'))

name: change_responses
description: Actor response to a specific change version; cannot acknowledge a newer change.

name: broadcasts
description: Operator-started city/pickup/date search with frozen offered revision.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('searching','accepted','stopped','expired','no_acceptance'))

name: broadcast_waves
description: Durable expansion schedule from operator-approved policy.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('scheduled','active','closed','cancelled'))

name: offers
description: Private offer recipient/scope/deadline; redacted pre-acceptance projection.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('offered','accepted','declined','expired','taken','withdrawn'))

name: freelance_agreements
description: Single accepted scope/economics snapshot; revisions append.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('active','completed','cancelled'))

name: fare_adjustments
description: Immutable agreed change/cancellation/return compensation ledger entries.

name: settlement_records
description: Earned/due/paid/disputed external settlement facts; no platform-held balance implied.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('open','closed','cancelled'))
earning_state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unearned' CHECK(earning_state IN ('unearned','earned','void'))
payment_state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unpaid' CHECK(payment_state IN ('unpaid','partially_paid','paid','overpaid'))
earned_minor bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(earned_minor>=0)
paid_minor bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(paid_minor>=0)

name: settlement_events
description: Append-only finance provenance and dispute/correction event.

name: transport_trips
description: Optional intercity physical leg; local city Round is separate.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('draft','scheduled','loading','departed','arrived','receiving','closed','cancelled'))

name: trip_bookings
description: Manifest reservation on a trip, independent of loading/receipt.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('booked','partially_loaded','loaded','partially_received','received','disputed','cancelled'))

name: trip_receipts
description: Destination receiving record with explicit discrepancies.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('partial','complete','disputed'))

name: conversations
description: Either authorized relationship context or job context; no universal cross-tenant room.

name: conversation_participants
description: Explicit participant and expiry; server recomputes access after reassignment.

name: messages
description: Human/system messages with source context and idempotent send.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('received','delivered','read','failed'))
privacy: Private communication; configured retention; no untrusted HTML

name: message_attachments
description: Staged/sent attachment relation; location is typed, not arbitrary executable content.

name: message_receipts
description: Participant received/read acknowledgements only from valid channel/client evidence.

name: call_sessions
description: Provider session/caller/callee; incoming/outgoing state and current job context.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('initiated','ringing','connected','declined','missed','ended','failed'))

name: call_events
description: Manual outcomes separate from provider-observed state.

name: notifications
description: In-app actionable pointer; fetch current state on open.

name: customer_tracking_tokens
description: Hashed audience-scoped revocable URL token.

name: notification_deliveries
description: Per-event audience/channel attempt identity with actual provider receipts.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('queued','provider_accepted','delivered','failed','unknown'))

name: provider_receipts
description: Deduplicated verified asynchronous provider facts; no automatic causal reinterpretation.

name: writeback_tasks
description: Normalized delivery result sent to source under permission and version checks.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('queued','sending','succeeded','failed','unknown'))

name: route_estimates
description: Licensed provider estimate with explicit profile/input/freshness; no unconditional provider-content storage.

name: navigation_intents
description: Destination ledger deduplicates remount/retry; real SDK billing observed separately.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('created','opened','superseded','expired','failed'))

name: tracking_entitlements
description: Server-enforced time/purpose boundary on driver tracking; no permanent team surveillance.

name: current_positions
description: One hot observation per driver; late historical batch cannot rewind it.
privacy: Exact location server-only; minimised projections per job/tenant

name: location_samples
description: Raw high-volume samples; production time partitions and short retention policy required.
privacy: Short-lived raw GPS; partition rollout and measured purge cadence

name: route_trails
description: Derived Rounds-owned actual trail and quality record where retention permits.

name: command_receipts
description: Server command dedupe/state; scope_key computed from authenticated actor plus tenant.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('in_progress','queued','committed','rejected','retained_for_review'))
rules: CHECK (city_id IS NULL OR tenant_id IS NOT NULL)
privacy: Server-only response projections; no signed URLs/secrets in cached result

name: domain_events
description: Append-only authoritative facts plus aggregate version and cause identity.

name: outbox_events
description: Transactional enqueue intention, retried until acknowledged; no external call in transaction.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('queued','sending','delivered','retry','failed'))

name: job_runs
description: Durable scheduled job state; pgmq contains IDs, not sensitive payload copies.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('queued','running','retry','completed','failed','cancelled'))

name: consumer_receipts
description: Idempotent event/job consumer effect receipt; tenant check still required.

name: audit_access
description: Privileged sensitive read/export/access provenance.

name: export_jobs
description: Asynchronous scoped history/subject export and signed download lifecycle.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('queued','running','ready','failed','expired'))

name: privacy_requests
description: Access/deletion workflow with verified subject scope and retention/legal hold checks.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('requested','reviewing','approved','rejected','executing','completed','held'))
privacy: Restricted compliance operations; periods require approved policy

name: retention_holds
description: Preserve selected evidence for incident/dispute without disabling all purges.

name: slot_occurrence_bindings
description: Single current admission pointer per template/date; lock this row while resolving revisions and reserving capacity. Old occurrences remain promise evidence.

name: account_events
description: Private account/driver events for commands without a tenant; never publish into a merchant channel.
privacy: Account owner and authorized service only; no merchant read access

name: account_outbox
description: Durable private account event delivery; separate from tenant outbox.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('queued','sending','delivered','retry','failed'))

name: custodians
description: V2 custodians; see owning command and state contracts.
rules: CHECK ((kind='principal' AND principal_id IS NOT NULL AND site_id IS NULL) OR (kind='site' AND site_id IS NOT NULL AND principal_id IS NULL))
privacy: Scoped operational data; private service access and reviewed retention

name: custody_transfers
description: V2 custody transfers; see owning command and state contracts.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending','partially_received','received','declined','cancelled','expired'))
rules: CHECK (state NOT IN ('partially_received','received') OR (received_at IS NOT NULL AND received_by IS NOT NULL))
privacy: Scoped operational data; private service access and reviewed retention

name: custody_transfer_lines
description: V2 custody transfer lines; see owning command and state contracts.
fields: received_quantity numeric(18,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(received_quantity>=0)
privacy: Scoped operational data; private service access and reviewed retention

name: return_task_lines
description: V2 return task lines; see owning command and state contracts.
fields: received_quantity numeric(18,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(received_quantity>=0)
privacy: Scoped operational data; private service access and reviewed retention

name: trip_booking_lines
description: V2 trip booking lines; see owning command and state contracts.
fields: received_quantity numeric(18,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(received_quantity>=0)
privacy: Scoped operational data; private service access and reviewed retention

name: remaining_obligations
description: V2 remaining obligations; see owning command and state contracts.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('open','planned','resolved','cancelled'))
privacy: Scoped operational data; private service access and reviewed retention

name: remaining_obligation_lines
description: V2 remaining obligation lines; see owning command and state contracts.
fields: resolved_quantity numeric(18,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(resolved_quantity>=0)
privacy: Scoped operational data; private service access and reviewed retention

name: inbound_dependencies
description: V2 inbound dependencies; see owning command and state contracts.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('awaiting_receipt','partial','ready','discrepancy','cancelled'))
privacy: Scoped operational data; private service access and reviewed retention

name: realtime_grants
description: V2 realtime grants; see owning command and state contracts.
privacy: Scoped operational data; private service access and reviewed retention

name: agreement_revisions
description: Append-only accepted amendments; the agreement initial accepted snapshot never changes.
privacy: Accepted contractual evidence; scoped finance/operations/driver entitlement

name: driver_tracking_grants
description: Server-issued purpose/time limited entitlement to an operating driver location; a relationship alone grants no off-duty GPS.
fields: purpose text NOT NULL CHECK(purpose IN ('team_shift','accepted_round','accepted_trip','recovery'))
privacy: Server entitlement management; scoped operations read, no client creation

name: fulfillment_units
description: One whole-delivery execution identity at launch. Split/child units are prohibited.
fields: state text NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('open','collected','delivered','returned','cancelled'))
rules: CHECK(parent_unit_id IS NULL AND remaining_obligation_id IS NULL)
privacy: Scoped operational records; explicit retention and access policy

name: fulfillment_unit_lines
description: V2.2 fulfillment unit lines; see consolidated domain specification.
fields: delivered_quantity numeric(18,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(delivered_quantity>=0)
returned_quantity numeric(18,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(returned_quantity>=0)
cancelled_quantity numeric(18,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(cancelled_quantity>=0)
privacy: Scoped operational records; explicit retention and access policy

name: offline_evidence_observations
description: V2.2 offline evidence observations; see consolidated domain specification.
privacy: Scoped operational records; explicit retention and access policy

name: settlement_payments
description: V2.2 settlement payments; see consolidated domain specification.
fields: direction text NOT NULL CHECK(direction IN ('payment','refund'))
privacy: Scoped operational records; explicit retention and access policy

name: dispute_cases
description: V2.2 dispute cases; see consolidated domain specification.
fields: kind text NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('financial','evidence'))
state text NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('open','investigating','decided','closed'))
rules: CHECK((kind='financial' AND agreement_id IS NOT NULL AND proof_submission_id IS NULL) OR (kind='evidence' AND proof_submission_id IS NOT NULL AND agreement_id IS NULL))
privacy: Scoped operational records; explicit retention and access policy

name: gps_retention_holds
description: Restricted retention administration; no dispatcher access.

name: gps_purge_audit
description: Restricted retention administration; no dispatcher access.
fields: occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
